How about the Shopline Widget

Let me outline the complete plan, and then you can tell me whether you agree.

We could organize the work into these milestones:

1\. Begin with a 1 day codebase audit covering the agents, Avelin AI integration, Supabase, user flow, and backend architecture. Then make the Styling Agent / mood board feature the first primary milestone.

2\. Next, test selfie styling through the backend and share the results with you before we decide whether to develop the complete feature.

3\. Afterward, implement usage tracking, credits, and Stripe subscriptions together since those pieces are interrelated.

4\. Treat analytics and minor website fixes as smaller tasks.

5\. I think Shopline should have its own milestone because it involves OAuth, product APIs, content/blog APIs, webhooks, and review compliance.

Following the audit, I’ll be able to estimate the time for every milestone more accurately.

My first step would be a 1 day codebase audit of the agents, Avelin AI integration, Supabase, user journey, and backend architecture.
Afterward, please tell me how you want the milestones divided according to your business priorities, and I’ll provide a proper estimate for each.

Ok, I’ll provide access to DO and Supabase. Shopline is still part of the same budget, even if it is organized as a separate milestone. Have you previously developed for Shopline? They offer what they call a dev account, although honestly I have not explored it much. The main advantage is that everything can be fetched from our platform.

Before adding Stripe, we must measure token usage for each specific prompt and use it to create the monetization tier. I hope you have experience with that?
[CLIENT_NAME_001], I’m familiar with that

We should implement the usage-tracking layer before Stripe.
For every Avelin AI call, we’ll record the user, agent, prompt type, token consumption, and estimated cost in Supabase. That will let us determine average usage for each prompt and design subscription tiers from actual data rather than assumptions.

For shopline, I first need to inspect the dev account and verify the exact API workflow.
